body.zh-Hant: 克里斯蒂安十世生於1870年9月26日。丹麥傳記辭典說他是第一位有中學畢業資格的丹麥國王，但軍事教育對他影響最強。他於1906年因祖父去世成為王儲，1908年升任少將。1912年父王弗雷德里克八世去世後繼位：該辭典記為1912年5月15日，Lex 條目則寫他於5月14日父親去世時成為國王，並於5月15日在阿馬林堡被宣布。
body.en: Christian X was born on 26 September 1870. The Dansk Biografisk Leksikon says he was the first Danish king to have passed the school-leaving examination, although the military side of his education was by far the strongest. He became crown prince in 1906 on the death of his grandfather and was made a major general in 1908. He succeeded his father Frederik VIII in 1912: the biographical dictionary gives 15 May 1912, while the Lex entry says he became king on 14 May, the day his father died, and was proclaimed on 15 May at Amalienborg.

heading.zh-Hant: 憲政糾紛、1915年憲法與北石勒蘇益格重回丹麥
heading.en: Constitutional disputes, the 1915 constitution and the return of Northern Schleswig

body.zh-Hant: 1914年8月5日德國要求在丹麥各海峽布雷，他在阿馬林堡的國務會議上近乎熱烈地支持布雷；並對戰時中立政策全力支持。1915年6月5日他在各黨支持的新六月憲法上簽名。1920年復活節危機中，他撤換了薩勒政府，在工會決定發動總罷工之後，他於4月4日復活節當天讓步，由中間內閣籌備選舉。1920年7月9日他簽署把北石勒蘇益格割讓給丹麥的條約，次日騎馬越過舊邊界進入日德蘭南部。
body.en: When Germany demanded on 5 August 1914 that the Danish straits be mined, he backed the mine-laying almost passionately at a council of state at Amalienborg; he fully supported the neutrality policy during the war. On 5 June 1915 he signed the new June constitution, backed by all parties. In the Easter Crisis of 1920 he dismissed the Zahle government; after the trade unions decided on a general strike, he gave way on Easter Day, 4 April, and a caretaker ministry was left to call elections. On 9 July 1920 he signed the treaty transferring Northern Schleswig to Denmark and on the next day rode across the old border into Southern Jutland.

body.zh-Hant: 1918年12月1日，丹麥—冰島聯合法生效，承認冰島為主權國家，但兩國仍為共主邦聯，由丹麥國王共同擔任國家元首；兩國只共有國王與外交，國王頭銜因此加上「冰島國王」。他以此身分在1921年首次訪問冰島。丹麥傳記辭典說他與冰島人的關係從未真正熱絡。1940年德國占領丹麥後，冰島議會撤銷丹麥國王的攝政權；聯合法於1943年底期滿，1944年6月17日冰島正式成為共和國。據丹麥傳記辭典，冰島改行共和時他致電祝福冰島民族的未來。
body.en: On 1 December 1918 the Danish-Icelandic Act of Union took effect and recognised Iceland as a sovereign state, but it remained in personal union with Denmark, with the Danish king as joint head of state; the two countries shared only the king and foreign policy, and 'King of Iceland' was added to his title. In that capacity he first visited Iceland in 1921, though according to the Dansk Biografisk Leksikon his relations with the Icelanders never became truly warm. After Germany occupied Denmark in 1940 the Althing withdrew the Danish king's powers as regent; the Act of Union expired at the end of 1943, and Iceland formally became a republic on 17 June 1944. According to the dictionary, he sent a telegram wishing the Icelandic nation well when it adopted the republic.

body.zh-Hant: 1940年4月9日德軍進攻時，他與政府一致認為繼續抵抗毫無希望，同意停火。他在占領下的每日騎馬成為國民象徵，1940年9月26日七十歲生日更成為全國慶典。1942年9月他72歲生日時，希特勒致電祝賀，他只簡短回電；10月他墜馬，之後健康衰退。1943年8月28至29日夜間德軍衝入他所在的宮殿，他事實上成為宮中囚犯。1945年5月4日晚解放消息經BBC傳來，次日他向國民發表廣播演說，5月9日坐輪椅出席議會重開。
body.en: When the Germans attacked on 9 April 1940 he agreed with the government that further resistance was hopeless and accepted the order to cease fighting. His daily rides through Copenhagen under the occupation made him a national symbol, and his 70th birthday on 26 September 1940 became a national festival. At his 72nd birthday in September 1942 Hitler sent him a congratulatory telegram, which he answered very briefly; in October he fell from his horse and his health declined. On the night of 28–29 August 1943 German troops stormed the palace where he was and he was in effect a prisoner there. The news of liberation came over the BBC on the evening of 4 May 1945, and the next day he gave a radio address, and on 9 May he attended the reopening of the Rigsdag in a wheelchair.

body.zh-Hant: 維托里奧·伊曼紐三世1869年11月11日生於那不勒斯，父親是翁貝托一世、母親是瑪格麗塔。義大利傳記辭典說他二十歲起展開軍旅生涯，並具備錢幣學、歷史與地理方面的知識。1900年7月29日翁貝托一世遇刺，繼位為國王；GND 權威檔標示他在位期間為1900至1946年。
body.en: Victor Emmanuel III was born in Naples on 11 November 1869, the son of Umberto I and Margherita. The Dizionario Biografico degli Italiani says he began a military career at twenty and had knowledge of numismatics, history and geography. He came to the throne after Umberto I was assassinated on 29 July 1900; the GND authority record gives his reign as 1900 to 1946.

heading.zh-Hant: 法西斯上台與一黨體制
heading.en: Mussolini's rise and the one-party state

body.zh-Hant: 1922年墨索里尼籌備向羅馬進軍，法克塔前來請國王在法令上簽字時，國王拒絕簽字並決定另組政府，後來指派墨索里尼組閣。義大利傳記辭典分析他的考量包括王朝、對革命的恐懼，以及缺乏墨索里尼以外的替代人選。1925年12月至1926年1月間，國王簽署了「最法西斯」的法律，使首相只對國王負責，並取締法西斯黨以外的政黨。
body.en: In 1922, when Mussolini prepared the March on Rome, King Victor Emmanuel refused to sign the decree that Facta brought him for signature and decided to form a new government; Mussolini was then charged with forming it. The Dizionario Biografico lists dynastic considerations, fear of revolution and the scarcity of alternatives to Mussolini among his reasons. Between December 1925 and January 1926 the king signed the 'fascistissime' laws, which made the head of government responsible only to the monarch and dissolved all parties except the Fascist one.

heading.zh-Hant: 帝國、元帥銜與併吞阿爾巴尼亞
heading.en: Empire, the marshalcy and the annexation of Albania

body.zh-Hant: 1936年他被宣布為皇帝；GND 權威檔載明他為衣索比亞皇帝（1936–1941）與阿爾巴尼亞國王（1939–1943）。1938年3月參議院設立「帝國第一元帥」一階，同時授予領袖與國王，他一度威脅不簽署。1939年4月義大利迅速併吞阿爾巴尼亞，傳記辭典說他認為此舉是不必要的冒險。
body.en: In 1936 he was proclaimed emperor; the GND record lists him as Emperor of Ethiopia (1936–1941) and King of Albania (1939–1943). In March 1938 the Senate created the rank of First Marshal of the Empire and conferred it on both the Duce and the king, and he threatened not to sign the law. In April 1939 Italy rapidly annexed Albania, which the dictionary says the king judged an unnecessary risk.

heading.zh-Hant: 墨索里尼倒台、逃離羅馬與退位
heading.en: The fall of Mussolini, the flight from Rome and abdication

body.zh-Hant: 1943年7月25日法西斯大議會通過格蘭迪議案後，國王下令讓卡賓槍兵逮捕墨索里尼，改由巴多利奧組閣。9月3日他簽署無條件投降書，9月8日艾森豪宣布停戰後，他在深夜離開羅馬南下。1944年6月5日他把全部權力與「王國副王」職位交給王儲翁貝托。1946年5月9日他退位，流亡埃及，1947年12月28日去世。
body.en: On 25 July 1943, after the Grand Council of Fascism approved the Grandi motion, the king had Mussolini taken into custody by the carabinieri, and Pietro Badoglio became head of government. On 3 September he signed the unconditional surrender, and after Eisenhower announced the armistice on 8 September he left Rome in the middle of the night for the south. On 5 June 1944 he assigned all powers and the post of Lieutenant General of the Realm to his son Umberto. He abdicated on 9 May 1946, went into exile in Egypt, and died on 28 December 1947.

body.zh-Hant: 胡安·比森特·戈麥斯生於1857年7月24日，出生地是塔奇拉州的拉穆萊拉莊園。他自1892年起流亡哥倫比亞，至1899年5月23日為止；隨後西普里亞諾·卡斯特羅出征時，他已具將軍銜並任遠征軍第二指揮，同年10月22日進入加拉加斯。1901年制憲議會任命他為第二副總統，1905年起為第一副總統。1908年11月23日卡斯特羅因病離開權力，戈麥斯以第一副總統身分接掌總統職務。
body.en: Juan Vicente Gómez was born on 24 July 1857 at the La Mulera estate in Táchira. He lived in exile in Colombia from 1892 until 23 May 1899; in the expedition that followed he already held the rank of general and was second-in-command, and the force entered Caracas on 22 October 1899. In 1901 the Constituent Assembly named him second vice-president, and from 1905 he was first vice-president. On 23 November 1908 Castro left power because of illness and Gómez took over the presidency as first vice-president.

heading.en: The 1908 coup and the provisional and constitutional presidencies

body.zh-Hant: 1908年12月19日，戈麥斯以一封據稱卡斯特羅發自柏林的電報為藉口發動行動，撤換卡斯特羅派軍官並逮捕仍效忠卡斯特羅的部長。1909年8月5日國會通過憲法修正，總統任期縮為四年；8月11日他當選臨時總統。1910年4月25日國會晉升他為「大將」（general en jefe），4月27日選他為憲法總統。1913年他決定繼續掌權，並中止選舉程序，1914年1月1日凱旋進入加拉加斯。
body.en: On 19 December 1908, using a cable supposedly sent by Castro from Berlin as a pretext, Gómez began his move, dismissing the Castroist military chiefs and arresting the ministers who remained loyal to Castro. On 5 August 1909 Congress approved a constitutional reform cutting the presidential term to four years, and on 11 August he was elected provisional president. On 25 April 1910 Congress raised him to the rank of general en jefe (full general), and on 27 April elected him constitutional president. In 1913 he decided to remain in power, and suspended the electoral process, and he entered Caracas in triumph on 1 January 1914.

body.zh-Hant: 1914年4月19日，全權代表國會決定指定戈麥斯為臨時總統兼陸軍總司令，隨即又以維克托里諾·馬爾克斯·布斯蒂略斯為臨時總統，戈麥斯保留陸軍總司令一職。1915年5月3日國會選他為1915至1921年任期的憲法總統，但他留在馬拉凱，由馬爾克斯·布斯蒂略斯在加拉加斯處理多數行政事務。第一次世界大戰期間（1914至1918年）他維持中立。1921年12月他幾乎因病喪命，後來推動修憲，國會再選他連任1922至1929年。
body.en: On 19 April 1914 the Congress of Plenipotentiaries named Gómez provisional president and commander-in-chief of the army, then named Victorino Márquez Bustillos provisional president, leaving Gómez commander-in-chief. On 3 May 1915 Congress elected him constitutional president for 1915–1921, but he stayed in Maracay while Márquez Bustillos handled most administration in Caracas. He kept the country neutral during the First World War (1914–1918). In December 1921 he nearly died of illness; he then promoted a constitutional reform, and Congress re-elected him for 1922–1929.

body.zh-Hant: 1929年4月總統任期屆滿後，戈麥斯推動修憲，恢復總統與陸軍總司令分設，推薦胡安·包蒂斯塔·佩雷斯為總統候選人並讓自己被指定為陸軍總司令；此安排維持到1931年6月，佩雷斯被迫辭職，總統與總司令再度合併。1931年7月7日他最後一次宣誓就任總統。他於1935年12月17日在馬拉凱去世；德國國家圖書館權威檔稱他為「1908至1935年的將軍與獨裁者」。
body.en: After the presidential term ended in April 1929, Gómez promoted a constitutional reform restoring a separate president and commander-in-chief of the army, recommended Juan Bautista Pérez as presidential candidate and had himself designated commander-in-chief; the arrangement lasted until June 1931, when Pérez was forced to resign and the two offices were again merged. On 7 July 1931 he took the presidential oath for the last time. He died in Maracay on 17 December 1935; the German National Library authority record calls him a general and dictator from 1908 to 1935.
